name: Shadow Thread
description: Pull a single thread of shadow from the palm and flick it across the back of the target's hand.

name: Shadow Loop
description: Twist shadow into a loop and drop it over a wrist to hold the arm for a moment.

name: Shadow Sheet
description: Spread a flat sheet of shadow before the body that dulls an incoming cut and hides the guard.

name: Weave Step
description: Cross two paces of open ground behind a trailing weave of shadow that breaks the line of sight.

name: Loom Jab
description: Snap a jab through a hole in a woven screen so the fist appears where no gap was seen.

name: Woven Cloak
description: Weave a close cloak of shadow round the shoulders that lends the next movements the cover of dimness.

name: Shadow Net
description: Throw a wide net of woven shadow that settles on the arms and legs of the foe and tightens.

name: Shadow Screen
description: Hold a tall screen of woven shadow before the group that hides them and turns aside light blows.

name: Smother Palm
description: Push a palm into the chest so the dark qi it carries presses on the lungs and shortens the breath.

name: Snuff Fingers
description: Pinch out a small flame or a glowing talisman between two fingers wrapped in dark qi.

name: Quench Guard
description: Slap a thrown spark or ember aside with a forearm that drinks the heat out of it.

name: Choke Step
description: Close the gap in two short steps with dark qi muffling each landing and each breath.

name: Wick Jab
description: Drive two stiff fingers at the hollow of the throat as if to pinch out a wick.

name: Smother Wave
description: Sweep an arm to send a low wave of dark qi that snuffs flames and pushes the dark into lungs.

name: Smother Press
description: Hold both hands out and press a weight of dark on the foe until breath and strength both fail.

name: Veil Lift
description: Raise a thin veil of dark qi from the shoulders to hide the face and the hands.

name: Veil Slap
description: Whip the edge of the veil across the eyes of the foe in an open-handed slap.

name: Veil Turn
description: Draw the veil across the line of a thrust and let it slide off the cloth of dark.

name: Veil Glide
description: Glide behind the falling veil to a spot two paces to the left or the right.

name: Thin Gauze
description: Cast a thin gauze of dark across the eyes of one foe so edges and faces go grey.

name: Veil Gaze
description: Look out through the veil and read which of the people nearby are tense and ready to move.

name: Wide Veil
description: Stretch the veil over several allies at once and hold it so blows and sight both slide off.

name: Heavy Veil
description: Drop a heavy veil over a knot of foes so they lose each other and the way forward.

name: Veil Strike
description: Strike through the thick of the veil so the blow comes from nowhere the foe was watching.

name: Shade Slip
description: Step into a shadow cast by a wall or a body and leave it from another a pace beyond.

name: Shade Cut
description: Strike with the edge of the hand the moment the shade is left behind and the foe is unready.

name: Shade Mark
description: Mark the shadow of a foe with a touch of dark qi and feel where it moves afterwards.

name: Shadow Ward
description: Pull a patch of dark ground up in front of the body and take a hit on it.

name: Long Slip
description: Cross a full room through connected shadows in a single breath and come out behind the foe.

name: Umbral Stab
description: Leave the shadow at the foe's back and drive a heavy blow into the spine before it can turn.

name: Dread Touch
description: Lay two cold fingers on the arm of the foe and let a flicker of dread run up the nerve.

name: Cold Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries a shiver of fear as well as the weight of the blow.

name: Dread Stare
description: Hold the eyes of one foe and let dark qi seep out so his arm trembles and drops.

name: Cold Guard
description: Chill the air before the chest into a hard wall of dark that stops a blow short.

name: Dread Step
description: Walk forward slowly through a dim passage and let the pressure of the dark go ahead of the body.

name: Unease
description: Seep a sense of dread into a foe nearby so his breathing and his timing both slip.

name: Dread Read
description: Feel where the fear sits in each foe and mark the weakest nerve in the line.

name: Cold Dread
description: Let the full pressure of the dark settle on one foe until his limbs go slack with fear.

name: Dread Wave
description: Push a wave of dread outward that breaks the timing of every foe near the user.

name: Frozen Blow
description: Strike a foe already shaken by dread so the blow lands while the guard is still locked.

name: Ink Drop
description: Let a drop of dark ink fall from the fingers and fly into the face of the target.

name: Ink Stain
description: Splash dark ink across a foe's chest so the stain clings and shows him as a mark to dim.

name: Ink Brush
description: Sweep the open fingers across the foe in a brushing blow that leaves a smear of dark.

name: Ink Guard
description: Pour a short sheet of ink down the forearm and take a cut on it without a mark.

name: Ink Slip
description: Slide across wet floor on a sheet of dark ink and come up beside the foe.

name: Ink Trace
description: Mark the air with a faint line of dark ink and read how it bends round moving bodies.

name: Ink Flood
description: Pour a flood of dark ink over the ground that stains every foot and drags at each step.

name: Ink Lock
description: Let the ink dry fast on the limbs of a foe until it sets as a stiff black cuff.

name: Light Sip
description: Take a sip of the glow from a nearby lamp or a talisman and leave its holder in dimness.

name: Glow Eater
description: Bat aside a bolt of bright qi with a forearm that eats part of its light on contact.

name: Dark Bite
description: Close the fingers on the foe's arm and bite into its glow with a dark grip.

name: Gulp Step
description: Draw the light out of a doorway and step through its fresh dark before it refills.

name: Dim Taste
description: Sample the light of a room with dark qi and learn which glowing things are hidden in it.

name: Great Gulp
description: Drink the light from a whole hall until every flame and glow within it sinks to embers.

name: Dark Return
description: Hurl back a bolt of stolen light as a lance of dark that stings where it strikes.
